scientific limitations/integrity: Assumes the printed tau_S=tau_I=tau_R=1 continuous PDE, classical solutions, rectangular domain, homogeneous Neumann data, and positive I for the unregularized chemotactic flux. No claim is made about PDE well-posedness, stability, or the time-discrete implementation. The conservation calculation is elementary; the substantive claim is the sharp universal pointwise-closure criterion and its application to the printed model.
title: Exact population conservation and the sharp pointwise-closure boundary in spatial SIR
